scope: Astra source-only investigation; no SSH, device access, register reads/writes or boot performed

evidence.linux_sysfs: Root separately observed spi0.0 bound to spi-hid-apple-of and Apple SPI Keyboard 001C:05AC:0341.0001; no event node opened. This is Linux evidence, not Darwin enumeration.

selected_path.board: ADT target-type J293, compatible J293AP/MacBookPro17,1/AppleARM; arm-io,t8103
selected_path.controller: /arm-io/spi3 compatible spi-1,spimc, physical 0x23510c000 length 0x4000, AIC IRQ 617, clock-gate 52, clock-id 379
selected_path.device: /arm-io/spi3/ipd compatible hid-transport,spi; bootloader-type HIDDevice; keyboard and trackpad share this transport
selected_path.gpio: main GPIO 0x23c100000 pins 46..49 function 1; enable pin 195 GPIO output; nub GPIO 0x23d1f0000 pin 13 active-low input
selected_path.timing: Linux J293 DT: 120 MHz parent, 8 MHz SPI, mode 0, CS setup/hold 65 us, inactive 250 us
selected_path.phandles: ADT GPIO 0x77, nub GPIO 0x79, AIC 0x70. Linux phandles are different and must never be copied into the guest ADT.
selected_path.exclusions: spi0 is Touch Bar, spi2 is fingerprint, spi1 is firmware/NVRAM, spi4 is display; none are keyboard targets. No MTP node. m1n1 trace_keyboard.py explicitly targets 2021 models and its GPIO numbers are inapplicable.

blockers.evidence: 50 fileset entries and 62 __PRELINK_INFO personalities inspected; no hid-transport,spi / spi-1,spimc / gpio,t8101 match

blockers.finding: Apple arm-io descendants are not published by current generic platform bus walker
blockers.action: A board-gated IOResources adapter may resolve exact gIODTPlane paths directly; do not assume an existing SPI provider

blockers.finding: Current PDAppleBootCPUPMGR is CPU idle policy, not device-domain control
blockers.action: Resolve and validate PMGR devices/ps-regs against the observed SPI3 and GPIO parent chain before MMIO; never reset or power down shared SIO parents

blockers.finding: IOHID enumeration alone cannot produce input
blockers.action: Read real SPI HID boot response, device/interface metadata and HID descriptor; publish an IOHIDDevice and submit only validated device-1 input reports

console_route.finding: NO_KERNEL_HID does not suppress this tree's custom PDHID keyboard-to-console path
evidence: xnu/config/MASTER.arm64.t8103:55 selects no_kernel_hid; xnu/iokit/Kernel/IOPMrootDomain.cpp:333 uses it for display-wrangler presence
IOHIDFamily/IOHIDFamily/IOHIDEventService.cpp:1794 calls PDHIDPushKeyboardEvent for keyboard usages without NO_KERNEL_HID guard
IOHIDFamily/IOHIDSystem/PDHIDEventQueue.cpp:388,454,477,538 queues actual key events and calls cons_cinput outside the queue lock
xnu/bsd/dev/arm/km.c:397-408 routes cons_cinput through tty line discipline
Actual KC symbol tables contain pd_hid_console_key, pd_hid_console_work, PDHIDPushKeyboardEvent and cons_cinput
console_route.ownership: Opening /dev/usb_hid_kbd grabs the queue and suppresses text-console feed; inventory must only stat it. Its historical usb name and serial virtual HID activity do not prove physical keyboard input.
console_route.recommendation: Preserve NO_KERNEL_HID and the serial recovery path; implement missing physical transport rather than removing unrelated compile guards.

implementation_contract.owned: integrations/puredarwin/m1-keyboard excluding root-owned inventory/ and Grok-owned protocol/
implementation_contract.first_transport: Serialized, bounded FIFO PIO; no SIO DMA, DART mappings, firmware uploads or quarantine changes. Poll active-low ready GPIO from a workloop timer; no fabricated GPIO interrupt success.
implementation_contract.writes: Board/property/range checks precede mapping/writes. Verify SIO_BUSIF/SIO and always-on NUB_GPIO; activate ordinary SPI_P/GPIO/SPI3 domains if needed, without releasing reset/disable and without power-down. BUSY bounded at 100 us; each RMW uses a fresh sample. GPIO RMW preserves unrelated bits and refuses every locked pin. Reset enable 1/0/1 with 5/5/50 ms from pinned Linux driver. Controller hardware IRQ mode with IE registers zero.
implementation_contract.transactions: One 256-byte RX packet, or 256-byte TX then 200 us then four-byte write status under one CS assertion; setup/hold/inactive delays preserved. A single transaction deadline bounds all FIFO waits. Invalid levels, underrun/overflow, incomplete bytes, status/CRC failure are failures.
implementation_contract.lifetime: One serialized owner; stop controller, disable local IRQ enables and deassert CS on failure. Never unmap while a workloop callback can run. Do not power down shared PMGR parents during cleanup.
implementation_contract.protocol_handoff: Native adapter selects root-owned native_protocol/dl_spi_hid.c. Grok protocol/ is an independent comparison implementation. Both are untouched by Astra.
